_doc: Asset kinds: the budget table from docs/art-style.md, machine-readable.
tris: [min, max] render triangles (colliders excluded). Over max fails the verifier;
under min is a warning. bevel: [min, max] metres, a guide for main-body edges;
default_bevel is what a part gets when it doesn't say. near: metres, the closest the kind is
usually seen from; one pixel there (85 deg vertical FOV, 1440 lines: near * 1.27 mm) is the
smallest detail hb builds: narrower bevels are dropped and auto lathe segments keep the
silhouette within it. bevel_segments: what a part gets when it doesn't say; 1 is a chamfer,
2 rounds it (at about 2.5x the bevel's triangles), only worth it where bevels are several
pixels wide all game long: a weapon in first person. Keep this in step with art-style.md.
